problem_statement: agno-agi/agent-ui (re-skinned here as the Larkfield Ops Console, a self-hosted operations console for coordinating field-service crews and dispatch queues) is a Next.js 15 App Router + Tailwind + zustand chat workspace: a left operations sidebar (dispatch endpoint, mode + agent selector, model display, session list) beside a right conversation surface that shows the running dispatch transcript of message bubbles with a sticky composer. The conversation surface hosts a native 'channel filter' at the top of the transcript: a tab row (All / Dispatch / Crews / Network) with a live readout that scopes the transcript to a single dispatch channel and reports 'Showing N of M turns'. A recent change left this channel filter in a broken state on the conversation surface. Three things are wrong and must be repaired together. (1) Responsive: the channel tab row is pinned to a fixed 560px width with wrapping disabled, so on a 390px phone the tabs refuse to wrap and force the whole document to scroll sideways (~210px of horizontal overflow at 390px), while desktop still fits. (2) Layout / legibility: the tab row is pulled out of flow so it detaches and overlaps the first transcript turns, and the message bubbles collide; the transcript reads as a broken, overlapping stack rather than a clean thread. (3) Interaction: clicking a channel tab does re-filter the visible turns, but the 'Showing N of M turns' readout is frozen at 'Showing 8 of 8 turns · All' and never updates to reflect the selected channel, so the readout lies about what is shown. Repair the transcript channel filter so the tab row wraps without horizontal overflow on mobile, the tab row and message bubbles no longer overlap and stay legible, and the readout updates to match the active channel and the shown turn count on every click. The seeded transcript content, the sidebar chrome, and every other surface stay unchanged.
required_content: The transcript channel-filter tab row must not force horizontal document overflow at 390px; the mobile conversation surface fits the viewport width.
The channel tab row and the transcript message bubbles must not overlap or collide, and the bubble text stays legible (readable contrast) on desktop and mobile.

Clicking a channel tab (Dispatch / Crews / Network) filters the transcript to that channel AND updates the 'Showing N of M turns · <channel>' readout to match the shown turns; the readout is not frozen.
The four channel tabs (All, Dispatch, Crews, Network) and the seeded dispatch transcript turns remain present with their model/token/latency metadata.
The channel filter is exposed on both the transcript and the sidebar session list (a 'Channel filter' scope in the Sessions area), consistent across the console.
The operations sidebar (dispatch endpoint, mode + agent selector, model display, sessions) stays present and unchanged.
No new console errors, failed network requests, or runtime warnings are introduced; the console stays clean across all captured states.
design_constraints: Preserve the Larkfield Ops Console visual language: dark surface, rounded bordered bubble cards, DM Mono / Geist typography, and the two-pane sidebar + conversation layout.

The repair is scoped to the transcript channel filter (its responsive tab row, its non-overlapping layout, and its readout wiring); do not restructure the sidebar, the composer, or the seeded transcript content.
Do not hide content behind clipping, remove tabs, or drop transcript turns to mask the overflow or the overlap; the tabs and turns must stay fully visible and legible.
Keep the channel tabs on a single row on desktop where there is room; only the narrow-viewport wrapping behaviour should change.
The readout must be derived from the active channel and the shown turn count so it can never disagree with the visible turns.
The change is a layout/CSS + client-state repair inside the channel-filter component; no backend, routing, or data changes are involved.
state_constraints: desktop_initial captures the conversation surface at 1440px: the operations sidebar, the transcript of dispatch message bubbles, and the sticky composer, with no horizontal overflow.
tablet_initial captures the same surface at 834px.
mobile_initial captures the surface at 390px: this is where the defective fixed-width, non-wrapping channel tab row forces the document to scroll sideways; the repair must eliminate that overflow.

desktop_transcript scrolls the transcript to the top at 1440px so the channel filter tab row, its readout, and the first message bubbles are all in frame; the reference shows a clean wrapped tab row above legible non-overlapping bubbles, while the defective versions show the tab row detached and overlapping the bubbles.
mobile_transcript is the same top-of-transcript view at 390px; the defective channel tab row overflows and the bubbles collide, so the reference and defective renders differ markedly here.

desktop_channel_dispatch clicks the 'Dispatch' channel tab from desktop_transcript: the transcript filters to the Dispatch turns and the reference readout updates to 'Showing 4 of 8 turns Dispatch', whereas a defective readout stays frozen at 'Showing 8 of 8 turns All'.

Source inspection confirms the app is a Next.js App Router client application whose seeded transcript content is identical across the defective and repaired versions; only the channel-filter layout, legibility, readout wiring, and the sidebar channel-scope presence differ.

change_completion: The mobile conversation surface no longer has horizontal document overflow beyond a small tolerance.
Clicking a channel tab updates the 'Showing N of M turns' readout to match the shown turns.
The channel tabs and the transcript turns remain fully present and readable after the repair.
design_consistency: The repaired channel filter keeps the bubble card styling, spacing, and typography of the console.
The channel filter is exposed consistently on both the transcript and the sidebar session list.
regression: The operations sidebar and its selectors stay present and unchanged.
No new console errors or failed network requests are introduced.
responsive: At 390px the channel tab row wraps and the surface fits the viewport with no sideways scroll.
The tab row and message bubbles reflow without overlapping or clipping on mobile.

author_notes: Repo-grounded Repair/regression_continuity task on the agno-agi/agent-ui Next.js 15 App Router chat console (re-skinned Larkfield Ops Console). The native lever is the console's own conversation surface: a transcript channel filter (tab row + live turn-count readout) over the seeded dispatch message bubbles, mirrored by a channel scope in the sidebar session list. Four orthogonal defects are repaired together: a fixed-width non-wrapping tab row that overflows on mobile, a detached tab row plus shingled illegible bubbles, a frozen readout that ignores the clicked channel, and a missing sidebar channel scope. The seeded transcript content and DOM are byte-identical across the defective and repaired versions; the differentiators are no_horizontal_overflow on mobile (tol 24), a visual_regression over the transcript view, cross-view dom_assertions on the channel-filter presence, and an interaction_assertion on the channel-tab readout. All remote backend calls are neutralized to a deterministic local seed as declared infrastructure (identical across legs) so the console renders offline with a completely clean console.
